'''Tower Defense Simulator''', or more commonly, '''TDS''', is a tower defense game created by [[Paradoxum Games]] on Roblox. Officially released on the 14th of June 2019, players are tasked with defending the exit from hordes of enemies using the towers they've curated. This wiki aims to be the definitive source for everything '''Tower Defense Simulator'''!
